collected_data.limits: Incomplete, selection-dependent observations; no network or station performance ranking.

sample_data.limits: Design demonstrations, not measured reliability or forecasts. Null destination values are excluded without assigning a reason.

ideas.name: Delay recovery
ideas.method: Horizontal waterfall of successive reported arrival delays
ideas.reveals: Accumulation and recovery that a final-stop punctuality percentage can hide
ideas.limit: Change between arrivals includes intervening travel and dwell time; it does not identify a cause.

ideas.name: Train paths
ideas.method: Rotated Marey diagram with selected scheduled-versus-observed arrivals
ideas.reveals: Timing relationships and where a service falls behind its schedule
ideas.limit: Station spacing is schematic; joined arrival timestamps are not continuous locations or a speed measurement.

ideas.name: Delay fabric
ideas.reveals: Whether bad days coincide across stations, and persistent differences between rows
ideas.limit: Daily percentage denominators are not included in this station list, so cell size does not encode observation volume.

ideas.name: Arrival ranges
ideas.method: Individual observed delays, median, 10th–90th percentiles, and full observed range
ideas.reveals: Similar medians can hide very different rare long delays
ideas.limit: Empirical observation ranges, not confidence or forecast intervals.

ideas.name: Buffer curves
ideas.method: Complementary empirical cumulative distribution of destination arrival delays
ideas.reveals: The fraction of reported arrivals exceeding each possible time buffer
ideas.limit: Small samples are shown with their denominators; curves summarize history rather than guarantee future outcomes.

ideas.name: Delay ridges
ideas.method: Integer-minute histograms normalized by station sample count, on equal height scales
ideas.reveals: Delay distributions, concentration near zero, and long tails
ideas.limit: Unsmooth histograms avoid implying a continuous density from minute-rounded records; current incomplete-day profiles are selection-dependent.
